L12@P0: Re: October 1 Enrollment Data for Fiscal Year 2025
L13@P0: What is October 1 Enrollment Data?
L14@P0: To ensure compliance with federal reporting and program requirements for the fiscal year 2025, the
L15@P0: Arizona Department of Education (ADE) is compiling data for students enrolled on October 1, 2024.
L16@P0: AzEDS Reports populates data that Arizona school districts, charter schools, and public education
L17@P0: agencies (PEAs) (organizations) submit via their respective student information systems (SIS) to ADE and
L18@P0: has Passed Integrity in AzEDS accordingly.
L19@P0: Student-level enrollment, attendance, and program data at educational sites reported by organizations
L20@P0: are crucial to accurate funding and determinations for all education programs. ADE uses October 1 data
L21@P0: to manage eligibility and funding for limited federal dollars, comply with federal reporting requirements,
L22@P0: and serve as the basis for general population statistics about Arizona schools.
L23@P0: ADE uses October 1 data for internal and external accountability reports, such as the statewide dropout
L24@P0: rate, and to identify students in certain subgroups. Therefore, schools must review and, if applicable,
L25@P0: correct this data as soon as possible so that ADE can produce accurate numbers for federal reporting,
L26@P0: reconciliation of federal allocations, and preparation of preliminary allocations for fiscal year 2026.
L27@P0: What are the important deadlines?
L28@P0: The final October 1 enrollment data deadline is Wednesday, December 11, 2024. ADE requires
L29@P0: organizations to review and correct data submissions if there are inaccuracies. ADE encourages
L30@P0-1: organizations to contact their relevant ADE program area staff for support.1535 West Jefferson Street • Phoenix, Arizona 85007 • 602-542-5393 • www.azed.gov
L31@P1: What are the consequences of not submitting accurate, valid, and timely October 1 Enrollment Data?
L32@P1: ADE will not include any information submitted after 5:00 PM on December 11, 2024, into AzEDS on
L33@P1: the relevant grants or reports indicated in the chart below. Incomplete, inaccurate, or late reporting
L34@P1: from PEAs will result in the delay of state and/or federal funds, potential reductions of federal grant
L35@P1: funding, and other program enforcement as relevant.
